name: at freezes the last drawn position when a fix goes off route

steps.why: First valid fix anchors drawing at 100 m.
The next valid fix is at 200 m, setting speed to 10 m/s.
This fix is over 60 m from the route; at t=15 s the last drawn point is 250 m.
Once off route, drawing stays at the 250 m position from the report time instead of extrapolating another 50 m.
